recommendations.name: JITLine (replication package)
recommendations.description: A random-forest JIT defect predictor that flags defect-introducing commits and the risky lines within them, with open code on Zenodo (I could not confirm a GitHub repo), so it is a research package you would need to wrap yourself.

recommendations.name: SZZ Unleashed
recommendations.description: An open implementation of the SZZ algorithm that labels defect-introducing commits from git history, which you would need as the training-data step for any JIT predictor on your own repo.

recommendations.name: jit-sdp-retrospective-pf-validity (Song, Minku, Yao)
recommendations.description: A GPL-3.0 Python and MATLAB codebase that runs an online JIT software defect prediction stream, useful as a working reference but research code rather than a ready PR bot.
